moments.text: White-hot infrared view over cloud tops: a bright oblong blob, tilted down to the right, sits in the track gate below the crosshair.
After one striped frame the display switches to black-hot: the shape turns dark with a pale halo, still tilted down to the right.
The dark shape starts to rotate, flattening until it lies level at about 29.4 s.
It keeps turning and now tilts up to the right; the bearing readout at top passes from 1° L to 1° R.
The track gate widens to the left for about 0.6 s; the shape sits right of the gate centre with smeared edges.
The gate snaps back; the shape is tilted steeply up to the right as the clip ends at bearing 7° R.
